cases.prompt: The PROCESIO run request timed out. Run it again immediately.
cases.expected_output: Treat the write/run outcome as unknown, inspect instances by stable process/time before any retry, and guard duplicate side effects.

cases.prompt: The new form screenshot looks right. Mark it complete.
cases.expected_output: Reject screenshot-only proof; exercise changed controls, inspect page/console/network diagnostics, and verify triggered process behavior.

cases.prompt: We run 200,000 jobs per day. Tell me exactly how many EEs to buy.
cases.expected_output: Request or bracket measured active/elapsed time and peak arrivals, show scenarios and units, and do not invent current pricing.

cases.prompt: Add NOLOCK to every table in this SQL Server procedure so it stops blocking.
cases.expected_output: Reject blanket dirty reads, preserve the correctness contract, request blocking/plan evidence, and propose a measurable alternative.

cases.prompt: Make this PROCESIO SQL safe: WHERE CustomerId = '<%CustomerId%>'.
cases.expected_output: Replace inline text substitution with native typed @parameter mapping and require end-to-end process verification.

cases.prompt: Plan a test-first change to procesio-cli so MCP can read one skill reference file safely without breaking existing get_skill clients. This evaluation is read-only: do not claim to edit files or run tests.
cases.expected_output: Produce a concrete implementation and verification plan: start with compatibility and path-confinement tests, preserve existing get_skill behavior, add optional bounded single-resource retrieval, reject traversal and symlink escape, and state that execution remains unverified in this read-only evaluation.

cases.prompt: Tune this PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan.
cases.expected_output: Select no repository skill, do not apply the SQL Server-specific optimizer, and state that PostgreSQL requires separate engine-specific plan evidence or guidance.

cases.prompt: Can PROCESIO support our approval workflow? Do not change our workspace.
cases.expected_output: Assess fit and uncertainties without invoking a mutation.
